newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin feeling better - Tass quotes Kremlin.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin feeling better - Tass quotes Kremlin.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin, being treated in hospital for pneumonia, is feeling much better and his temperature and blood pressure are normal, Itar-Tass news agency quoted the presidential press service as saying.
"His condition has improved considerably, he is more physically active," the press service said. "There is only sporadic wheeziness in his lungs."
A Kremlin spokesman later confirmed the Tass report.
Yeltsin, 65, has been in hospital since last Wednesday, although he has been talking to Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin from his hospital room by telephone.
The press service said Yeltsin met chief-of-staff Anatoly Chubais in the hospital for 40 minutes on Tuesday.
Doctors have said Yeltsin's latest illness is not linked to the quintuple bypass operation he underwent on November 5. But they have given no date for the president to leave hospital.
